# ResourceId round-trips every supported IdStrategy

Source: [JSON](../../decisions/D106.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Date

2026-09-20

## Status

accepted

## Decision

Canonical wire form is `<type>:<strategy>:<value>`. Strategy is `uuid`, `ulid` or
`integer`; UUID includes default UUIDv7 and other canonical UUID values, ULID is
canonical uppercase, integer is positive canonical decimal without leading zero.
`ResourceId` owns parse/render and configured-id factories, with type/strategy mismatch
errors and no database lookup. The prefix grants no authority.

## Rationale

An external identifier must preserve the configured model key without lossy coercion or
an implicit dependency on one default strategy.

## D106 — ResourceId round-trips every supported IdStrategy

**Actor:** plan-designer/codex-gpt-5.6-sol/high
**Evidence:** `RAG:—` DA10 compares the ULID-only draft with the actual default UUIDv7
and supported UUID/integer strategies.

## Решение

Canonical wire form is `<type>:<strategy>:<value>`. Strategy is `uuid`, `ulid` or
`integer`; UUID includes default UUIDv7 and other canonical UUID values, ULID is
canonical uppercase, integer is positive canonical decimal without leading zero.
`ResourceId` owns parse/render and configured-id factories, with type/strategy mismatch
errors and no database lookup. The prefix grants no authority.

## Почему

An external identifier must preserve the configured model key without lossy coercion or
an implicit dependency on one default strategy.

## Consequences

P13.8 and the external fixture cover byte-stable UUIDv7, UUID, ULID and integer
round-trips plus malformed/cross-strategy negatives.
